Hi Sarah / Cobalt procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive call today — excited about Cobalt Analytics listing on GCP Marketplace and the co-sell motion with Google. To keep momentum, I put together a short intake and proposed mutual action plan so we can align procurement, legal, and the marketplace listing milestones.

Key asks from your side to unblock seller registration + procurement intake:
- Confirm legal billing entity (name + address) and preferred invoicing email
- PO cadence (monthly / quarterly / one-time) and required billing terms (net30/45/60)
- Any required purchase order template or internal contract clause redlines
- Primary technical contact for the marketplace listing metadata and validation

Attached: GCP_Listing_Prelim_Checklist.xlsx — quick fields we need for seller registration + listing page (logo, short descriptions, SKU-level pricing guidance).

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement Q&A (30 min) — week of Apr 19
2) Share MSA draft + SOW template (we can accept redlines) — by Apr 20
3) Marketplace metadata intake and technical validation with Google co-sell specialist — target Apr 26

Marissa (cc) will lead contract coordination; Jonas will own go-to-market packaging for co-sell messaging. Sarah — could you confirm the procurement contact and availability for a 30-minute sync next week?

Thanks,

Quick note from the GCP side — happy to coordinate the marketplace onboarding and co-sell nomination. High level:

- Co-sell: nominate through Partner Advantage -> Co-sell; requires a validated listing + a technical validation call (15-30 min)
- Timeline: if you submit metadata this week, we can schedule validation the week of Apr 26 and aim for listing approval in early May.

Action items for Redwood / Cobalt:
1) Provide metadata owner for the validation call (technical contact + calendar availability)
2) Provide SOC 2 and DPA (required for co-sell approval)

Relevant portal link: https://cloud.google.com/partner-advantage/marketplace (see seller registration -> submit offering).
